title: Your account
metaDescription: Sign in to GiBiScore to save your fantasy football auctions and reopen them from any device.
intro: With an account you save your fantasy football auctions in the cloud and reopen them from any device. The rest of the site needs no sign-in.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Enter your GiBiScore account
signIn.footer: Protect your account with a strong password
signIn.linkError: The link is no longer valid: sign in or sign up again

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.subtitle: Join GiBiScore today
signUp.footer: By signing up you accept our terms of service
signUp.errorUsernameMin: The username must be at least {min} characters long
signUp.errorPasswordMin: The password must be at least {min} characters long

errors.exists: An account with this email already exists: sign in
errors.rate: Too many attempts: try again in a few minutes

profile.title: My profile
profile.intro: Your betting slips and the shortcuts to your things.
profile.schedineHint: Every saved slip stays open until its matches are over, then settles itself on the real results: won or lost, with the outcome of every selection.

favorites.title: My favourites
favorites.emptyCompetitions: No favourite competition yet: use the star next to a league or a cup.
favorites.emptyTeams: No favourite team yet: use the star on a team's page.
favorites.hint: The stars are the same across the site and follow your account on every device. The matches of these competitions and teams come first in the list, their standings in the right-hand column, and they are the ones you get notifications for.
favorites.help: The stars are the same across the site and follow your account on every device. The matches of these competitions and teams come first in the list, their standings in the right-hand column, and they are the ones you get notifications for.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: For the matches of your favourite competitions and teams: a reminder an hour before, official lineups, kick-off, every goal with the scorer, red cards, half time and full time; in the evening the recap of your teams; and the outcome of your betting slips. They arrive even with the site closed.
notifications.deviceIsOff: This device does not receive notifications yet.
notifications.iosInstall: On iPhone and iPad notifications only arrive if you add GiBiScore to the Home Screen: in Safari tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen", and open the site from there.
notifications.unsupported: This browser does not support notifications.
notifications.notConfigured: Notifications are not set up on this site yet.
notifications.denied: The browser denied the permission: turn it back on in the site settings.
notifications.masterHint: While paused you get nothing on any device, without losing your settings: turn them back on whenever you like.
notifications.muteHint: Watching a match and want no spoilers? On the match page tap the bell to mute that one only. The muted matches are listed below.

password.title: Forgot your password
password.subtitle: Enter the account's email: we send you a link to choose a new password.
password.sentText: If {email} has an account, an email with the link is on its way. It lasts an hour; check the spam folder too.
password.footer: The link lasts an hour and works once.
password.newSubtitle: Choose one you use only here.
password.tooShort: The password must be at least {min} characters long
password.mismatch: The two passwords do not match
password.expiredText: The link is no longer valid or was already used: request a new one.
